sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 28 and Internal Quality Checks row 28 (Mukesh note: flows combine multiple verifiers, no separate retest)
.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (Known false positives: one criterion covering a whole flow, checks 26/28/33)
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (Independent credit takes precedence over flow grouping; A negative needs a successful control)
evidence: Built an observable-to-criterion map over all 16 functional, 6 polish and 4 visual criteria plus both gates. No graded target appears in two criteria and no pair demands incompatible products. Places where a duplicate looked likely are separated by different promise, actor or path. Client scope (signin_and_client_scope Part B, Gwen->M-12) differs from the staff wall (wall_every_route, Dev->M-12). Deleted text is absent from search and transcript for a different deletion route in each criterion: author delete and seeded expiry/the exact 7-day boundary (deleted_and_expired_messages), timer shortening (timer_changes leg 1-2), hold release (hold_scope_and_release leg 6), and durability (persistence). Transcript properties are split: heading, order, author, time, hold and versions in search_and_transcript B; the edited mark in edits_and_stale_edit leg 4; literal markup in safe_formatting; same-time order in sent_once_in_order B; access in signin and wall_every_route. The author deliberately avoids double grading. timer_changes line 138 says the versions viewer 'itself is graded in edits_and_stale_edit' and makes its own versions leg conditional, and persistence only notes whether an edited mark exists. Polish and visual grade craft or presentation (confirm dialog, Escape, highlight, 390px, likert looks) rather than the functional outcome. Remaining overlaps are policy-mandated positive controls or unavoidable layering, not double grading. Examples: Harriet's link preview/navigation in wall_mentions_and_links pairs with Dev's not-available, as REVIEW_POLICY requires. link_highlight needs the navigation that search_and_transcript A and message_links grade. Wrong-password refusal is repeated in the zero-weight render gate, signin A and refusal_in_place, but a gate failure already zeroes reward. Notes for adjacent rows 26/33/40, not defects here: some shared features act as preconditions across many binary criteria. The transcript page appears as a leg in about 8 functional criteria. Delete with the app's control is used in 7, and search in several. A submission missing one surface therefore loses credit on otherwise valid observations. wall_mentions_and_links also bundles link walls, mention walls and suggestion scoping into one 4.0 binary criterion. The judge.toml comment 'Each observable is graded in exactly one criterion' (line 38) is accurate for graded targets but not for shared preconditions. This is a source-only semantic review. No judge run was used and none is needed to establish pairwise independence.
